extracted.name: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars
extracted.description: These Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Bars are thick, chewy, and so easy to make! They make enough for a crowd and are easy to transport in your 9x13 pan. They have the perfect texture and plenty of chocolate chips!
ingredient_lines: 2 cups chocolate chips ((340g) semi-sweet, milk chocolate, or a little of both!)
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Lightly grease a 9 x 13 inch pan with cooking spray or line with parchment paper.
Beat Butter and Sugar: In a large mixing bowl beat together the butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar until smooth and light.
Add the eggs one at a time, mixing after each addition. Add the vanilla.
Mix Dry Ingredients: In a separate bowl combine the dry ingredients: salt, baking soda, baking powder, flour and rolled oats.
Combine: Add dry ingredients to the creamed mixture and stir until combined. Stir in chocolate chips.
Bake: Press into prepared pan and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Allow to cool completely before cutting.
categories: Chocolate chip oatmeal cookie bars recipe
